metadata.question: Does the location at coordinates 34.770153, -118.423217 (with a 300-meter radius) show a solar farm, rather than a water pond based on Landsat imagery from April 14, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking if a location shows a solar farm vs water pond based on Landsat imagery from April 14, 2020. Key considerations: 1. Location: 34.770153, -118.423217 with 300m radius 2. Date: April 14, 2020 (specific date) 3. Task: Distinguish solar farm vs water pond Strategy: - Use Landsat 8 (operational in 2020) - Focus on spectral signatures: water has low reflectance in NIR/SWIR, solar panels have distinct spectral patterns - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water - Solar farms typically show high reflectance in visible bands and characteristic patterns Data quality checks: - Check if Landsat 8 image exists for that specific date - If no image, try to find nearby dates (±7 days) - Check valid pixel count after cloud masking - Validate calculations Logic: - Calculate NDWI: (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) - Water typically has NDWI > 0, solar farms have NDWI < 0 - Also check reflectance patterns across bands - If NDWI strongly positive → water pond - If NDWI negative/neutral with characteristic solar farm pattern → solar farm Fallback: If no Landsat 8, try Landsat 7 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.423217, 34.770153]); const region = point.buffer(300); // 300-meter radius const date = '2020-04-14'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 let landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); let imageCount = landsatCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images on ${date}: ${imageCount}`); // If no image on exact date, try ±7 days if (imageCount === 0) { landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2020-04-07', '2020-04-21'); imageCount = landsatCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images in ±7 days: ${imageCount}`); } if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get best image (least cloud cover) const image = landsatCol.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); // 3. Calculate NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); // 4. Get pixel statistics const stats = ndwi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndwiMean = stats.get('NDWI_mean').getInfo(); const pixelCount = stats.get('NDWI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`NDWI Mean: ${ndwiMean?.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (ndwiMean === null || ndwiMean === undefined || isNaN(ndwiMean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Decision logic: Water typically has NDWI > 0, solar farms have NDWI < 0 // Threshold: NDWI > 0.1 suggests water, NDWI < -0.1 suggests solar farm if (ndwiMean > 0.1) { console.log("Evidence: High NDWI suggests water body"); console.log("B"); // Not a solar farm (it's water) } else if (ndwiMean < -0.1) { console.log("Evidence: Low NDWI suggests non-water surface (potential solar farm)"); console.log("A"); // Likely solar farm } else { console.log("Evidence: Neutral NDWI - inconclusive"); console.log("B"); // Default to not solar farm if uncertain } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
